subject: Burnout 3 saga Part 4: The end of the road?
author: ZombieTron
body:
😠 OK I give up! well, maybe not completely, but EA obviously are complete muppets! (except for Criterion Games).

I am soooooooooooooooooooooooooooooo angry about the servers being closed and the way this was communicated to us that I am going to add at least 10 o's to my sooooooooooo's 😠.

I am really depressed about the prospect of NEVER being able to play Burnout 3 online EVER again!

I was not expecting this! I had no warning! I was assured the servers were not closing anytime soon!!!! The news has even taken the wind out of my Paradise sail for today at least. I am feeling very unexcited about Burnout today... it is a dark, dark day.

But, worse than being sad for myself. I am sad for the new gamers who will never experience Red v Blue as it should be... in an online Road Rage event on Burnout 3.

--- The Original and the Best ---

subject: EA contact list
author: ZombieTron
body:
You can email EA at customerservice@ea.com

Or telephone their tech support on: 0870 2432435 in the UK, although this goes through a contact centre in the phillipines it opens a case file and they will email you.

You can find their contact number for your region in the back of the manual of any EA game.

Probably easier just to use the email address tho!

subject: Burnout 3 Servers Saga Part 3: Take Action!
author: ZombieTron
body:
Two emails later and I have not yet had a response, so its time to call for reinforcements! Who's with me?

If you feel as strongly as I do that the Burnout 3 Servers should not be closed. Please contact EA and let them know how you feel.

Burnout 3 is one of the best online racing games of all time, and to deny any new players who pick this game up as an Xbox Original the full experience of Burnout 3 online is just insane!!

We were assured when the Revenge servers (for original xbox and ps2) were closed that the Burnout 3 servers would be staying open! How can they close them now with only a week to go before Burnout 3 is downloadable???

Please contact EA! I need Burnout 3 online to be back!!!!

Thanks for helping!!!!

--- The Original and the Best ---

subject: Burnout 3 Servers Saga Part 2
author: ZombieTron
body:
OK, so after 3 telephone conversations and running the UOTrace program and after the 3 different telephone operators assuring me that the servers were up and running. I responded to the tech support email to ask what is going on? This is the response I got:

Hi,

Thank you for contacting us here at Electronic Arts Technical Support. I’m sorry for the difficulty with Burnout 3.

Unfortunately, the servers for this game has been sunsetted. This means that the servers for this game has been taken down and reallocated for much newer games that is going to be released. The official notice is given below:

http://www.ea.com/information.jsp

Should you require further assistance about this or any Electronic Arts games in the future please visit our website and review our extensive Self Help knowledgebase

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

I know this is wrong! Burnout 3: Takedown is not on the list, so I have replied saying I think they have made a mistake and closed the wrong server as they have not given the obligatory months notice about closing the Burnout 3 servers and to close them a week or two before it is being released as a Xbox Original for the 360 is Crazy!!!

Coming up in part 3: EA's Response!

--- The Original and the Best ---
